basic_details.short_information: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre Punjab (HBCH&RC Punjab) has announced 2 vacancies for Executive Assistant and Executive Administrative Officer posts on a contract basis. Eligible candidates can attend a walk-in interview on 10 December 2026. The notified pay for the posts ranges from Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 60,000 and Rs. 65,000 to Rs. 75,000 respectively, with age limits up to 40 years for Executive Assistant and up to 45 Years as on Date on walk in interview for Executive Administrative Officer. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Executive Assistant: Post Graduation from recognized university, preferably MBA. At least 3 years professional experience in similar capacity. Executive Administrative Officer: Graduate With Post Graduate Management Degree/Diploma in Human Resource Management / Labour Welfare / personnel Management / Industrial Relations / Health Administration. Experience of 08 Years in the H.R.D / Administration dealing with General Administration, Estate management, Canteen & Cafeteria, Horticulture, Pest Control, Event Management, Industrial Relations etc.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for HBCH&RC Punjab Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre Punjab (HBCH&RC Punjab) for filling contractual positions.

faq.question: Q2. What positions are available in HBCH&RC Punjab recruitment?
faq.answer: The available positions include Executive Assistant and Executive Administrative Officer for qualified professionals meeting the experience requirements.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been announced under this recruitment notification for various administrative and executive roles.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The mode of application is a Walk-in interview where eligible candidates must present themselves directly at the designated venue with required documents.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on 10 December 2026 at the specified HRD department location in Mohali.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Executive Assistant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Executive Assistant post is up to 40 years as calculated on the date of the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary range for the Executive Administrative Officer?
faq.answer: The salary for the Executive Administrative Officer ranges from Rs. 65,000/- to Rs. 75,000/- per month based on qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. What educational qualification is required for Executive Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduation degree from a recognized university, with a preference for an MBA along with relevant professional experience.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the H.R.D Dept, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, New Chandigarh, Medicity, Mohali, Punjab- 140901.

faq.question: Q10. What documents must candidates carry to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry bio-data, recent photographs, PAN card, Aadhar card, and original along with self-attested copies of educational and experience certificates.
